# GameSurf — contemporary Italian review

- Original source: [Robin Hood](https://www.gamesurf.it/recensioni/gioco/robin-hood-c7493)
- Author / publication: Gamesurf Staff; GameSurf.
- Language / date: Italian; 2002-12-02.
- Access: Substantial indexed opening and verdict inspected; direct article retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The reviewer argues that the opening mission initially makes the game look too similar to Commandos, while later play reveals greater freedom and multiple solutions. The inspected passage discusses avoiding guards, rationing arrows, paying beggars for information, using buildings, and provoking fights among soldiers with money bags.

The verdict gives 8/10 and praises original ideas and reduced frustration for newcomers. This is useful contemporary evidence of how the game’s early learning curve could obscure its broader systems. The complete intervening review text was not retrieved.
